target.title: refactor(security): consolidate secret primitives
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Secret display masking and constant-time secret comparison were split across a generic utility, plugin-local wrappers, and ad hoc forwarding helpers. That duplicated security-sensitive contracts and made exact behavior harder to audit.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Move the existing API-key display policy from `src/utils` to the security owner boundary without changing its empty, short-value, control-character, prefix/suffix, or UTF-16 code-unit behavior.
- Keep constant-time string comparison as exact padded UTF-8 byte equality, including equal-length `timingSafeEqual` inputs and explicit original-length rejection.
- Remove Browser, Voice Call, Webhooks, and Zalo forwarding wrappers so callers use the existing canonical Plugin SDK comparison export directly.
- Keep Talk Voice's one-consumer prefix display helper local instead of adding a new public Plugin SDK subpath.

## User Impact

No intended behavior change. Existing masked output remains byte-for-byte stable for covered inputs, and authentication/webhook comparisons retain exact string equality without unequal-length short-circuiting.

## Evidence

- LOC after trim: 15 files, `+87/-88` overall; production `+18/-44` (net `-26`); tests `+69/-44` (net `+25`); docs/generated/SDK contract `0`.
- Focused tests: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/security/secret-mask.test.ts src/security/secret-equal.test.ts extensions/browser/src/browser/server.auth-token-gates-http.test.ts extensions/voice-call/src/webhook-security.test.ts extensions/webhooks/src/http.test.ts extensions/zalo/src/monitor.webhook.test.ts` (5 shards, 74 tests).
- SDK exports: `node scripts/check-plugin-sdk-subpath-exports.mjs`.
- Exact-head build: delegated Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kwqbd0qcy7kdbm0drem3b76t`, Actions run `28717952266`, `pnpm build` passed.
- Exact-head changed gate: delegated Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kwqcenwwqjx66v5wqxessepp`, Actions run `28718419048`, full `pnpm check:changed` passed.
- Autoreview: `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode branch --base origin/main --prompt-file /tmp/secret-primitives-review.txt --stream-engine-output` — clean, no accepted/actionable findings, confidence `0.97`.
- Head SHA: `ea26400bb0d777c9ab7b615253675682535e5c53`.

Known proof note: current `origin/main`'s committed Plugin SDK API baseline hash is stale relative to a clean regeneration; this PR has no Plugin SDK surface diff, and the subpath export check plus build are green.
